acabaron: acabar — they finished, carried out, did (preterite 3rd pl.; acabaron lo so 'they carried out their own (business)', Pidal 'llevaron a cabo, hicieron'; = acabaron)
quexarse: quexar + se — to complain, protest (infinitive + enclitic reflexive se; veriedes quexarse 'you would have seen them protest'; = quejarse)
ssí: sí — yes (adverb of affirmation, spelled with doubled s; de ssí o de no 'yes or no'; = sí)
essol: esso + le — that … to him (neuter demonstrative esso + dative le cut to l; por essol diemos 'for that (reason) we gave him'; = eso le)
demandasse: demandar — he might claim, ask for (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg. in -asse; que al no nos demandasse 'that he should claim nothing else of us'; = demandase)
recudades: recudir — you answer, give satisfaction (present subjunctive 2nd pl.; quel recudades 'that you answer him', Pidal 'respondáis', 'deis satisfacción'; = respondáis)
otorgo: otorgar — I grant, consent to (present 1st sg.; assí lo otorgo 'I grant it so'; = otorgo)
espesos: espender — spent (past participle masc. pl., strong form, Latin expensus; not espeso 'thick'; espesos los han 'they have spent them', Pidal 'los han gastado'; = gastados)
fablavan: fablar — they were speaking (imperfect 3rd pl. in -ava-; = hablaban)
sso: so — his, her, their (unstressed possessive, the s doubled after a vowel; a sso sabor 'at their pleasure'; = su)
afinca: afincar — he presses hard, harries, urges (present 3rd sg.; mucho nos afinca 'he presses us hard'; = aprieta, acosa)
assíl: assí + le — so … him (assí 'thus, so' + le cut to l; assíl prende sabor 'so desire takes him', Pidal 'así le domina el deseo'; = así le)
manfestados: manifestar — confessed, having owned (past participle masc. pl.; with son in an active sense, quando manfestados son 'when they had confessed', Pidal 'cuando hubieron confesado', 'cuando reconocieron su deuda'; = manifestados)
vedamos: vedar — we forbid (present 1st pl.; non gelo vedamos 'we do not forbid it him'; = vedamos, prohibimos)
juvizio: juvizio — judgement, ruling (masc., Latin iudicium; en nuestro juvizio 'by our judgement', por juvizio 'as a judgement', Pidal 'juicio'; = juicio)
mandamos: mandar — we order, decree (present 1st pl.; = mandamos)
enterguedes: entregar — you hand over, pay back (present subjunctive 2nd pl., the r moved: enterg- for entreg-; que aquí lo enterguedes 'that you pay it back here', Pidal 'que le reintegren o le paguen'; = entreguéis)
tornárgelos: tornar + ge + los — to give them back to him/them (infinitive + dative ge (= le, old form before lo/los) + los; tornárgelos quiero 'I wish to give them back to them', querer + infinitive, not a split future; = devolvérselos)
enterguen: entregar — let them hand over, pay (present subjunctive 3rd pl., jussive, the r moved; enterguen a mio Çid 'let them pay my Çid', Pidal 'paguen'; = entreguen)
pechar: pechar — to pay, pay as a due or penalty (infinitive; los an a pechar 'they have to pay them'; = pagar)
ferrand: Ferrand — Fernando, one of the Infantes of Carrión (personal name, Ferran[d] Gonçálvez; = Fernando)
espendiésteslo: espender + lo — you spent it (preterite 2nd pl. espendiestes + enclitic lo, accent written; = lo gastasteis)
damos: dar — we give (present 1st pl.; por juvizio lo damos 'we give it by judgment, we so decree'; = damos)
páguenle: pagar + le — let them pay him (present subjunctive 3rd pl., jussive, + enclitic le; = que le paguen)
apreçiadura: apreçiadura — payment in kind, goods valued at a sum of money (fem.; páguenle en apreçiadura 'let them pay him in goods at a valuation', Pidal 'especie (opuesto a dinero), cosas equivalentes a una cantidad de moneda'; = pago en especie)
préndalo: prender + lo — let him take it (present subjunctive 3rd sg., jussive, + enclitic lo; = que lo tome)
aduzir: aduzir — to bring, lead in (infinitive, Latin adducere; veriedes aduzir 'you would have seen them bring'; = aducir, traer)
guarnizón: guarnizón — equipment, trappings, fittings (fem.; toda guarnizón 'every fitting'; = guarnición)
recibiólo: recibir + lo — he received it (preterite 3rd sg. recibió + enclitic lo; = lo recibió)
apreçiaron: apreçiar — they valued, appraised (preterite 3rd pl.; commo apreçiaron 'as they assessed it'; = apreciaron, closest tasaron)
tenia: tener — he had, held (imperfect 3rd sg., printed without accent; que tenia el rey 'which the king held'; = tenía)
enpréstanles: enprestar + les — they lend them (present 3rd pl. enpréstan + enclitic les, accent written; the lenders are unnamed; = les prestan)
ageno: ageno — another's, belonging to someone else (adjective; lo ageno 'what is another's'; = ajeno)
cumple: cumplir — it suffices, is enough (present 3rd sg., with a dative; non les cumple 'it is not enough for them'; = les basta)
escapan: escapar — they escape, come off (present 3rd pl.; mal escapan 'they come off badly'; = escapan, salen)
jogados: jogar — mocked, made sport of (past participle masc. pl., Latin iocari; cf. jugar; mal escapan jogados 'they come off ill, mocked'; = jugados, here probably 'burlados'; uncertain)

__broaden__.razón: razón — talk, speech, matter (dexad essa razón 'leave off that talk'; esta razón 'this matter'; = razón, here closest asunto, conversación) · also razón — 'word, voice' (en una razón 'with one voice, in agreement'; = razón) · also razón — fecha por razón 'made with good reason, with purpose' (the cap fitted for a purpose); also dezir mi razón 'state my case' · also razón — 'right, fitting, reasonable' (tod esto es razón 'all this is right'; = razón); acordar la razón 'to agree on what to answer' (acuerdan la razón 'they agree on their answer', Pidal 'convienen la respuesta') · also dar razón de — 'to give an account of, answer for' (dedes dello razón 'give an account of it')
__broaden__.dio: dar — he gave, struck (preterite 3rd sg.; un colpe dio 'he struck a blow'; = dio) · dar a + inf. 'to give (something) to be …-ed' (Dio a partir estos dineros 'he had this money shared out') · also dar — he dispatched, sent (Pidal: 'despachó, envió'; Dio tres cavalleros 'he dispatched three knights'; = envió) · also dar — I gave (1st sg., Pidal 'di yo'; tres mill marcos les dio 'I gave them three thousand marks'; = di)
__broaden__.si: si — if; si + subjunctive alone = 'if only …!' · si non — otherwise, if not (si non, do sopiéredes 'if not, wherever you learn'); si + future subjunctive 'if' (si nos falláredes 'if you find us') · also si — si'nulla = sin + nulla with -n assimilated before n- (si'nulla dubda 'without any fear' (or 'doubt'); = sin ningún miedo, sin ninguna duda) · also si non — 'except, but for' (si non a estos cavalleros 'except these knights'; = salvo) · also si — 'so', optative, = sí, with the present subjunctive in an adjuration (si vos vala el Criador 'so may the Creator help you') · also si — heading a direct question, as if it were indirect (si me los dades 'will you give them to me?'; Pidal, note to 1922: 'La conjunción si encabeza una interrogación directa'; = ¿…?)
__broaden__.fincó: fincar — he planted, set firm (preterite; fincar los inojos 'to kneel') · also fincar — he stayed, remained (el Campeador fincó con su mesnada 'the Cid stayed with his troop'; = quedó) · also fincar — to end, come to a stop (fincó la boz 'the claim ended', Pidal 'acaba la demanda'; = acabó)
__broaden__.gonçálvez: Gonçálvez — González, patronymic 'son of Gonçalo' (Gonçál[v]ez, the v supplied; here Asur González; = González) · also of Ferrand Gonçálvez, Fernando González, one of the Infantes of Carrión
